premises.text: Data control should be a fundamental human right that users have surrendered to giant corporations
premises.evidence_span: Data control should be a fundamental human right with equal data rights for all. Until now, we've surrendered this right to giant corporations

premises.text: Platform sync shows personal data organized, anonymized, and encrypted
premises.evidence_span: sync your platforms, like Facebook and Google, to see all of your personal data organized in simple categories, fully anonymized and encrypted

premises.text: User-held private-key encryption plus encrypted ML matching for targeted offers
premises.evidence_span: Our patented technology encrypts your data and only you have the private key. Ozone then runs encrypted machine learning to match only the data you want to share with offers that are targeted for you

premises.text: Approved companies subscribe to anonymized user data and users receive monthly payments
premises.evidence_span: companies you approve can pay to subscribe to your anonymized data. For each subscription, you receive a monthly payment

premises.text: Advertisers receive pre-approved audiences matched to targeted profiles for high-conversion marketing
premises.evidence_span: Ozone will return pre-approved audiences that match your targeted profile. Companies can engage these audiences in targeted ads and direct marketing that has a high likelihood of approval, high likelihood of conversion

premises.text: Consumers use free organize-and-secure tools while companies pay only for conversions
premises.evidence_span: consumers get simple, free tools to organize and secure their personal data, and companies get pre-approved audiences and only pay for conversions, not just eyeballs like on Facebook

premises.text: Lifetime data earnings can connect into bank 401k retirement contributions
premises.evidence_span: This $112,000 represents Lyndon's alternative retirement savings. We're working with a tier one bank to connect this directly into 401k contributions

domains.name: Privacy rights and encrypted data control
Reverse data subscriptions for users and advertisers

value.text: Take back control of personal data and monetize what big data earns on users
value.evidence_span: Take back control of your data, and take back the billions that big data is earning on you

causal_links.evidence_span: patented technology that protects user data forever
reverse subscription model where companies you approve can pay to subscribe to your anonymized data

notes: Singleton D3 retained: 401k connection presented as separately learnable path for capturing data earnings value. Patents kept inside encryption premise (§4.1.1).
